responsibility: This autogenerated file is the documentation-link companion to mips.opt for the MIPS target option parser. It maps individual MIPS command-line options such as ABI, ISA, ASE, floating-point, erratum-workaround, scheduling, and code-model switches to UrlSuffix entries in the GCC manual, allowing GCC’s generated option metadata to point diagnostics/help output and other option-table consumers at the corresponding sections of gcc/MIPS-Options.html.
